```{r}
#| label: tbl-ttcc-rtcc
#| tbl-cap: "Total tree canopy cover (TTCC) and residential tree canopy cover (RTCC) in block groups that contain parks"

# Set up TTCC and RTCCC comparison
ttcc_rtcc_table <- phx_bg_parks |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  mutate(diff = pct_tree_parks - pct_tree_wo_parks) |> 
  select(pct_tree_parks, pct_tree_wo_parks, diff) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    variable = factor(
      variable,
      levels = c("pct_tree_parks",
                 "pct_tree_wo_parks",
                 "diff")
    )
  ) |> 
  group_by(variable) |> 
  summarize(
    Mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    variable = case_match(
      variable,
      "pct_tree_parks" ~ "Total tree canopy cover (%)",
      "pct_tree_wo_parks" ~ "Residential tree canopy cover (%)",
      "diff" ~ "TTCC - RTCC (%)"
    )
  )

# Create table with flextable
ttcc_rtcc_table |> 
  flextable() |> 
  set_header_labels(variable = "") |> 
  colformat_double(j = c("Mean", "SD", "Median", "Min", "Max"), digits = 2)|> 
  flextable::footnote(
    i = 3,
    j = 1,
    value = as_paragraph("TTCC: Total tree canopy cover; RTCC: Residential tree canopy cover"),
    ref_symbols = "a",
    part = "body"
  ) |> 
  add_footer_lines(
    as_paragraph(as_i("N"), " = 176 block groups")
  ) |> 
  autofit()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-desc-stats
#| tbl-cap: "Descriptive statistics of the dataset"

# Create descriptive statistics table
desc_table <- phx_bg |> 
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |> 
  summarize(
    across(
      c(population, pct_hispanic, pct_black, adi_rank, pct_tree, tree_access),
      list(
        Mean   = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        SD     = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Min    = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Max    = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"
    )
  ) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("Variable", "Statistic"),
    names_sep = "__"
  ) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Statistic, values_from = value) |> 
  mutate(
    Variable = case_match(Variable,
                          "population"   ~ "Total population",
                          "pct_hispanic" ~ "Hispanic population (%)",
                          "pct_black"    ~ "Black population (%)",
                          "adi_rank"     ~ "ADI rank",
                          "pct_tree"     ~ "Residential tree canopy cover (%)",
                          "tree_access"  ~ "Park tree access score"
    )
  ) |> 
  # Preserve intended row order rather than alphabetical
  arrange(match(Variable, c("Total population", "Hispanic population (%)",
                            "Black population (%)", "ADI rank",
                            "Residential tree canopy cover (%)",
                            "Park tree access score")))

desc_table <- desc_table |> 
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      Variable %in% c("Total population", 
                      "Hispanic population (%)",
                      "Black population (%)", 
                      "ADI rank") ~ "Block group characteristics",
      Variable %in% c("Residential tree canopy cover (%)",
                      "Park tree access score") ~ "Outcome variables"
    ),
    across(c(Mean, SD, Median, Min, Max),
           ~ case_when(
             Variable %in% c("Total population", "ADI rank") ~
               sprintf("%.0f", .x),
             TRUE ~ sprintf("%.1f", .x)
           ))
  )

grouped <- desc_table |> 
  as_grouped_data(groups = "group")
group_rows <- which(is.na(grouped$group))
first_data_row <- min(which(is.na(grouped$group)))

grouped |>
  as_flextable(hide_grouplabel = TRUE) |> 
  italic(i = ~ !is.na(group), part = "body") |> 
  set_header_labels(Variable = "") |> 
  add_footer_lines(
    value = as_paragraph(as_i("N"), " = 988 block groups")
    ) |> 
  hline(i = 1, part = "body") |>
  hline(i = 5, part = "body") |> 
  hline(i = 6, part = "body") |> 
  fit_columns(max_width = 6.5)

```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-regress
#| tbl-cap: "Results of OLS and spatial error regression models for RTCC and PTAS"

# Extract pseudo-r2 from spatial error models
sum_err_canopy <- summary(err_canopy, Nagelkerke = TRUE)
sum_err_access_sqrt <- summary(err_access_sqrt, Nagelkerke = TRUE)

glance_custom.Sarlm <- function(x, ...) {
  s <- summary(x, Nagelkerke = TRUE)
  data.frame(nagelkerke = s$NK)
}

# Format R2 label
gof_map <- tribble(~raw, ~clean, ~fmt,
                   "aic", "AIC", 1,
                   "r.squared", "R²", 3,
                   "nagelkerke", "Pseudo-R²", 3)

# Create table
regress_table <- modelsummary(list("OLS" = ols_canopy,
                                   "Spatial error" = err_canopy,
                                   "OLS" = ols_access_sqrt,
                                   "Spatial error" = err_access_sqrt
                                   ),
                              coef_rename = c(
                                "pct_hispanic" = "Hispanic population (%)",
                                "pct_black" = "Black population (%)",
                                "adi_rank" = "ADI rank"),
                              estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
                              statistic = NULL,
                              stars = c("*" = .05, 
                                        "**" = .01, 
                                        "***" = .001),
                              gof_map = gof_map,
                              output = "flextable") |> 
  align(j = 2:5,
        align = "right",
        part = "all") |>
  add_header_row(
    top = TRUE,
    values = c("", "RTCC models", 
               "RTCC models", 
               "√PTAS models", 
               "√PTAS models"),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1)
  ) |> 
  merge_h(part = "header", i = 1) |> 
  align(part = "header", align = "center") |> 
  flextable::footnote(
    i = 1,
    j = 2,
    value = as_paragraph("RTCC: Residential tree canopy cover; √PTAS: Park tree access score (square-root transformed)"),
    ref_symbols = "a",
    part = "header"
  ) |> 
  flextable::footnote(
    i = 6,
    j = 1,
    value = as_paragraph("AIC: Akaike information criterion"),
    ref_symbols = "b",
    part = "body"
  ) |> 
  flextable::footnote(
    i = 7,
    j = 1,
    value = as_paragraph("R² is reported for OLS models; Nagelkerke pseudo-R² is reported for spatial error models"),
    ref_symbols = " c",
    part = "body"
  ) |> 
  add_footer_lines(
    as_paragraph("* ", as_i("p"), " < 0.05, ** ", as_i("p"), 
                 " < 0.01, *** ", as_i("p"), " < 0.001")
  ) |> 
  add_footer_lines(
    as_paragraph(as_i("N"), " = 988 block groups")
  ) |> 
    fit_columns(max_width = 6.5)
  
regress_table
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-multinom
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| tbl-cap: "Multinomial logistic regression odds ratios for canopy access categories HL (High RTCC/Low PTAS), LH (Low RTCC/High PTAS), and LL (Low RTCC/Low PTAS) compared to HH (High RTCC/High PTAS)"

# Format stars
fmt_stars <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
         ifelse(p < 0.01, "**",
                ifelse(p < 0.05, "*",
                       ifelse(p < 0.1, "†", ""))))
}

# Build data frame
mn_table <- data.frame(
  Predictor = c("Hispanic population (%)", "Black population (%)", "ADI rank"),
  HL_OR = paste0(formatC(odds[1, 2:4], format = "f", digits = 2),
                 fmt_stars(p_15[1, 2:4])),
  HL_CI = paste0(formatC(ci[2:4, 1, 1], format = "f", digits = 2), ", ",
                 formatC(ci[2:4, 2, 1], format = "f", digits = 2)),
  LH_OR = paste0(formatC(odds[2, 2:4], format = "f", digits = 2),
                 fmt_stars(p_15[2, 2:4])),
  LH_CI = paste0(formatC(ci[2:4, 1, 2], format = "f", digits = 2), ", ",
                 formatC(ci[2:4, 2, 2], format = "f", digits = 2)),
  LL_OR = paste0(formatC(odds[3, 2:4], format = "f", digits = 2),
                 fmt_stars(p_15[3, 2:4])),
  LL_CI = paste0(formatC(ci[2:4, 1, 3], format = "f", digits = 2), ", ",
                 formatC(ci[2:4, 2, 3], format = "f", digits = 2))
)

mn_table |> 
  flextable() |> 
  add_header_row(
    top = TRUE,
    values = c("",
               "HL", 
               "LH", 
               "LL"),
    colwidths = c(1, 2, 2, 2)
  )|> 
  set_header_labels(
    HL_OR = "OR", HL_CI = "95% CI",
    LH_OR = "OR", LH_CI = "95% CI",
    LL_OR = "OR", LL_CI = "95% CI"
  ) |> 
  merge_h(part = "header", i = 1) |> 
  align(part = "header", align = "center") |> 
  flextable::footnote(
    i = 2,
    j = 2,
    ref_symbols = "a",
    value = as_paragraph("OR: Odds ratio; CI: Confidence interval"),
    part = "header"
    ) |> 
  add_footer_lines(
    as_paragraph("Reference category: HH (High RTCC/High PTAS)")
    ) |> 
  add_footer_lines(
    as_paragraph("† ", as_i("p"), " < 0.1, * ", as_i("p"), " < 0.05, ** ", as_i("p"), " < 0.01, *** ", as_i("p"), " < 0.001")
  ) |> 
  add_footer_lines(
    as_paragraph(as_i("N"), " = 988: HH = 89, HL = 122, LH = 404, LL = 373")
  ) |> 
  fit_columns(max_width = 6.5)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bin-regress
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| tbl-cap: "Binary logistic regression results for canopy access categories before and after spatial filtering"

# Named lists of fitted models
unfiltered <- list(HH = HH_glm, 
                   HL = HL_glm, 
                   LH = LH_glm, 
                   LL = LL_glm)
filtered <- list(HH = HH_glm_sf, 
                 HL = HL_glm_sf, 
                 LH = LH_glm_sf, 
                 LL = LL_glm_sf)

# Tidy all unfiltered models, tag with category names
unfiltered_coefs <- imap_dfr(unfiltered, ~ tidy(.x) |> 
                               mutate(category = .y)) |> 
  mutate(stage = "unfiltered")

# Tidy all filtered models, drop eigenvector rows, tag with category names
filtered_coefs <- imap_dfr(filtered, ~ tidy(.x) |> 
                             filter(!grepl("^fitted\\(", term)) |> 
                             mutate(category = .y)) |> 
  mutate(stage = "filtered")

# Bind all coefficients together
all_coefs <- bind_rows(unfiltered_coefs, filtered_coefs)

# Convert p-values into stars
add_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p < 0.1 ~ "†",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

# Combine estimate and stars into one formatted string
all_coefs <- all_coefs |> 
  mutate(estimate_fmt = paste0(round(estimate, 3), add_stars(p.value)))

# Recode column names to readable labels
term_labels <- c(
  "(Intercept)" = "(Intercept)",
  "pct_hispanic" = "Hispanic population (%)",
  "pct_black" = "Black population (%)", 
  "adi_rank" = "ADI rank"
)

all_coefs <- all_coefs |> 
  mutate(term = recode(term, !!!term_labels))

# Create wide coefficient table
coef_table <- all_coefs |> 
  select(category, term, stage, estimate_fmt) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = stage, 
                     values_from = c(estimate_fmt)) |> 
  as_grouped_data(groups = "category") |> 
  as_flextable(hide_grouplabel = TRUE) |> 
  set_header_labels(
    term = "Term", 
    unfiltered = "β (unfiltered)",
    filtered = "β (filtered)"
  ) |> 
  italic(
    i = ~ !is.na(category),
    part = "body"
    ) |> 
  add_footer_lines(
    as_paragraph("† ", as_i("p"), " < 0.1, * ", as_i("p"), " < 0.05, ** ", as_i("p"), " < 0.01, *** ", as_i("p"), " < 0.001")
                   ) |> 
  add_footer_lines(
    as_paragraph(as_i("N"), " = 988 block groups")
    )|> 
  hline(i = 1, part = "body") |>
  hline(i = 5, part = "body") |>
  hline(i = 6, part = "body") |>
  hline(i = 10, part = "body") |>
  hline(i = 11, part = "body") |>
  hline(i = 15, part = "body") |>
  hline(i = 16, part = "body") |>
  autofit()
  
coef_table
```
